name: native:buffer
description: Creates a buffer polygon around features at a specified distance. Params: INPUT, DISTANCE, SEGMENTS, END_CAP_STYLE, JOIN_STYLE, MITER_LIMIT, DISSOLVE

name: native:centroids
description: Creates centroid points for each feature (polygon or line). Params: INPUT, ALL_PARTS

name: native:clip
description: Clips one vector layer by the extent of another. Output contains only features within the overlay layer. Params: INPUT, OVERLAY

name: native:union
description: Computes the union of all input layers. Overlapping features are split at their boundaries. Params: INPUT, OVERLAY, OUTPUT

name: native:intersection
description: Computes the geometric intersection between two layers. Only overlapping areas are kept. Params: INPUT, OVERLAY, INPUT_FIELDS, OVERLAY_FIELDS

name: native:dissolve
description: Merges features by attribute value or all features into one. Params: INPUT, FIELD, SEQUENCE, NUMERIC

name: native:reprojectlayer
description: Reprojects a vector layer to a different coordinate reference system. Params: INPUT, TARGET_CRS

name: native:selectbyattribute
description: Selects features in a layer based on attribute value. Params: INPUT, FIELD, OPERATOR, VALUE

name: native:selectbyexpression
description: Selects features using a QGIS expression. Params: INPUT, EXPRESSION, METHOD

name: native:addfieldtoattributestable
description: Adds a new field to the attribute table. Params: INPUT, FIELD_NAME, FIELD_TYPE, FIELD_LENGTH, FIELD_PRECISION

name: native:deletecolumn
description: Removes one or more fields from the attribute table. Params: INPUT, COLUMNS

name: native:fieldcalculator
description: Creates or updates a field with values computed from an expression. Params: INPUT, FIELD_NAME, FIELD_TYPE, FIELD_LENGTH, FORMULA

name: native:joinattributestable
description: Joins attribute tables based on a common field. Params: INPUT, INPUT_FIELD, JOIN, JOIN_FIELD, FIELDS_TO_COPY, METHOD

name: native:mergevectorlayers
description: Combines multiple vector layers into a single layer. Params: LAYERS, CRS, TABLE

name: native:multiparttosingleparts
description: Converts multipart features to separate single-part features. Params: INPUT, OUTPUT

name: native:countpointsinpolygon
description: Counts points in each polygon and optionally calculates statistics. Params: POLYGONS, POINTS, FIELD, WEIGHT, CLASSFIELD

name: gdal:rasterize
description: Converts vector features to raster. Params: INPUT, FIELD, BURN, USE_Z, UNITS, WIDTH, HEIGHT, EXTENT, NODATA, OPTIONS, DATA_TYPE

name: gdal:warpreproject
description: Reprojects and warps raster layers to different CRS. Params: INPUT, SOURCE_CRS, TARGET_CRS, RESAMPLING, NO_DATA, TARGET_RESOLUTION, OPTIONS

name: gdalogr:buffervectors
description: Buffers vector features using GDAL/OGR. Params: INPUT, DISTANCE, OPTIONS, OUTPUT

name: qgis:zonalstatistics
description: Calculates statistics for raster values within zones (polygons). Params: INPUT_RASTER, RASTER_BAND, INPUT_VECTOR, COLUMN_PREFIX, STATISTICS

name: QgsMapSettings
description: Holds configuration for map rendering. To get the center point of the visible map, use mapSettings.extent().center() which returns a QgsPointXY. There is NO .center() attribute directly on QgsMapSettings.

name: QgsMapCanvas
description: Qt widget for displaying map layers. Import from qgis.gui, NOT qgis.core. Use iface.mapCanvas() to get the canvas instance. Common methods: refresh(), setExtent(extent), center(), zoomScale(), currentLayer().

name: QgsMapToPixel
description: Converts pixel coordinates to map coordinates. Arguments must be integers, not floats. Use int(round(x)) or int(round(y)) to convert floats before calling.

name: processing.run OUTPUT
signature: processing.run(name: str, parameters: dict, context=None, feedback=None, flags=None) -> dict
description: Returns a dict with OUTPUT key containing a FILE PATH (string), NOT a QgsVectorLayer object. NEVER treat result["OUTPUT"] as a layer. To load it: layer = QgsVectorLayer(path, name, "ogr"); QgsProject.instance().addMapLayer(layer). If you wrap it without adding to project, the C++ object will be deleted and you will get "wrapped C/C++ object has been deleted".

name: QgsProject.addMapLayer
signature: addMapLayer(layer: QgsMapLayer, addToLegend: bool = True, takeOwnership: bool = False) -> QgsMapLayer
description: Adds a layer to the project and the canvas. CRITICAL: if you create a QgsVectorLayer from a file path but do not add it to the project, the C++ object will be garbage-collected and accessing it later raises "wrapped C/C++ object has been deleted". ALWAYS addMapLayer() immediately after creating a layer.

name: QgsVectorLayer constructor
signature: QgsVectorLayer(path: str, baseName: str, providerLib: str)
description: Creates a layer from a file path (e.g., ".shp", ".gpkg", ".geojson"). The providerLib is usually "ogr". The layer IS NOT added to the project automatically. You MUST call QgsProject.instance().addMapLayer(layer) to keep the C++ object alive.

name: import processing
description: The processing module is a TOP-LEVEL module, NOT inside qgis.core. Correct: import processing. Wrong: from qgis.core import processing. After importing, use processing.run(algorithm_id, parameters) to execute QGIS Processing algorithms.

name: urllib.request http POST
description: To make HTTP requests inside run_qgis_code, use urllib.request (available in sandbox) or requests (available if installed). For POST: req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body.encode(), headers={...}, method="POST"); urllib.request.urlopen(req). Do NOT use subprocess for curl/wget.

name: subprocess blocked
description: The subprocess module is PROXIED in the sandbox and ALL its functions raise RuntimeError. NEVER generate code using subprocess.run(), subprocess.call(), os.system(), or shell commands inside run_qgis_code. Use download_file tool for downloads, or run_shell tool (requires approval).

name: star imports forbidden except qgis
description: Star imports (from X import *) are forbidden EXCEPT for qgis.core, qgis.gui, PyQt6.QtCore, and PyQt6.QtGui. For all other modules, import individual names: from qgis.core import QgsVectorLayer, QgsProject.

name: QColor vs QgsColor
description: THERE IS NO QgsColor in qgis.core. Use QColor from PyQt6.QtGui for colors. Example: from PyQt6.QtGui import QColor; c = QColor(255, 0, 0). Qgs classes that return colors (like QgsSymbol.color()) return QColor objects.

name: Syntax error self-correction
description: If run_qgis_code returns a sandbox syntax error, the Python code is invalid. Common causes: missing colons, unclosed brackets, wrong indentation, or mixing single/double quotes. ALWAYS ensure valid Python syntax. Test with ast.parse(code) before returning. Do NOT use backticks or markdown formatting inside code strings.

name: XYZ tile layer canvas CRS
description: XYZ tile layers (OpenStreetMap, Google Satellite, etc.) use Web Mercator (EPSG:3857). If the canvas is in a different CRS, tiles fetch but do not render visually. ALWAYS set the canvas CRS to EPSG:3857 before or after adding XYZ layers: iface.mapCanvas().setDestinationCrs(QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem("EPSG:3857")).

name: refreshAllLayers for XYZ tiles
description: After adding XYZ/tile/raster layers, ALWAYS call refreshAllLayers() then repaint() to force tile providers to reload. refresh() alone may not trigger tile fetching. Full sequence: canvas.refreshAllLayers(); canvas.repaint(); canvas.refresh().

name: Common XYZ tile URLs
description: Common XYZ URLs for QGIS. Use type=xyz in WMS provider. OpenStreetMap: url=https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png. Google Satellite (no key): url=https://mt1.google.com/vt/lyrs=s&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}. Stamen Terrain: url=https://tiles.stadiamaps.com/tiles/stamen_terrain/{z}/{x}/{y}.png. Always set layer transparency CRS to EPSG:3857.

name: QgsRasterLayer XYZ constructor
description: To add an XYZ tile layer: uri = "type=xyz&url=https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png&zmax=19&zmin=0"; layer = QgsRasterLayer(uri, "OpenStreetMap", "wms"); QgsProject.instance().addMapLayer(layer). The provider MUST be "wms" (not "xyz"). Then set canvas CRS to EPSG:3857 and call refreshAllLayers().
